mapper.insert: insert into crm_contract_log (contract_id, action, action_name, from_status, to_status, content, operator_id, operator_name, create_time) values (#{contractId}, #{action}, #{actionName}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{content}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, contract_id, action, action_name, from_status, to_status, content, operator_id, operator_name, create_time from crm_contract_log where contract_id = #{contractId} order by id desc

select id, contract_id, action, action_name, from_status, to_status, content, operator_id, operator_name, create_time from crm_contract_log where contract_id = #{contractId} and action in ('AUDIT_PASS', 'AUDIT_REJECT') order by id desc
